name: <system name>
description: Template: copy the structure, not the values. DTCG 2025.10 resolver skeleton: theme family x mode without one file per combination. Family files hold palette ramps and structure (radius, density, type voice); mode files map semantic colour roles to ramp steps by reference ({family.neutral.50}, {family.neutral-dark.50}), so every family gets every mode. Later entries in resolutionOrder win. Referenced *.tokens.json files are yours to create. Check that the host toolchain reads resolvers before relying on this file; otherwise ship per-mode files.

foundation.description: Global constants: space, type scale, durations. Same in every theme and mode.

semantic.description: Non-colour roles (space.inset, radius.control, text.body) and component exceptions, referencing foundation and family tokens.

theme.description: Theme family: a personality, not a hue. Each family defines the same token paths.

mode.description: Colour roles per mode, written as references to the active family's ramps.
